summary: Ascella signed-coherence coefficient acquisition: 64 settings, 17 primary endpoints, theory atlas and frozen native request
scope: One 64-setting Ascella order-family job measuring sign-odd X/Y and sign-averaged dark coefficients at five angles plus a commuting mutation, under a 300-second cap and a 1.2-credit ceiling, with the coefficient atlas rendered from its retained counts.
next_action: Build the frozen 64-setting twelve-mode native request and replay it locally against the ideal case and both counterexamples.

reconciliation.note: The derivation, endpoints and theory atlas are retained; the native request, its local replay, the written case and any submission remain prospective.

steps.action: Generate the serialized 64-setting request: twelve-entry input, twelve-mode circuit, output width twelve, explicit empty mitigation, budgets and exact entry order.
steps.acceptance: A builder writes the request with a digest, and a check rejects any setting whose full unitary, analyzer or output width differs from the design.

steps.action: Replay the frozen request through the local SLOS backend and run the registered estimators on the ideal response, the equal-contrast mutation counterexample and the sign-even counterexample.
steps.acceptance: The ideal replay qualifies every primary endpoint; the equal-contrast counterexample fails mutation closure; the sign-even counterexample keeps all fifteen primary coefficients ideal while its descriptive sign-even response reaches the 0.19 magnitude replay.py records.

steps.action: Write the acquisition case with fresh availability, tariff and expected credits, and wait for the user's approval.
steps.acceptance: An approved case names the request digest, samples, cap and expected credits; without approval nothing is submitted.
